Hi Markus —

Quick note from our side. BluePeak has a company-wide office closure and limited availability later this month: most of the product and procurement teams are offline for planning from Dec 20–31, and several people are out for a customer summit Dec 15–17. Given that, we may not be able to run the full technical demo the week of Dec 20 as originally discussed.

Can we either:
- Move the live demo earlier (we have a window on Tue Dec 14, afternoon PST), or
- Push it to the first week of January (week of Jan 4) when everyone's back?

If neither is possible, would you be able to have someone else from your team run a shorter 30–45 minute handoff/demo the week of Dec 11 while our engineers are still available?

Cc'ing our purchasing inbox for timeline visibility.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Best,
Katherine Ruiz
Senior Product Manager
BluePeak Systems
katherine.ruiz@bluepeak.com
+1 415-555-0186

Thanks for the heads up and the options. I'm traveling to RSA the week of Dec 5–9 and then will be out of the office intermittently the two weeks after, so I won't be the best point for a late-week demo. I want to make sure we don't lose momentum on BP-47.

Two proposals:
1) We can advance to Tue Dec 14, 2:00–3:00 PM PST. I'll ask Laura (cc'd) to run the session and Aditya to join for the deep-technical Q&A.
2) If Dec 14 won't work for you, hold it for Mon Jan 4 / Tue Jan 5 (first week of January) — I'll be back and can lead then.

I've attached a short 'coverage playbook' that Laura can use for the shortened walkthrough (agenda, who covers which feature, and escalation contacts).

Laura — can you confirm availability to run Dec 14 afternoon and take the invite? Aditya, do you have capacity for a technical deep-dive if we go with the Dec 14 option?
